self_review_mechanism.loop: Search -> Classify -> Count -> Review: هل غطيت كل الجوانب؟ هل أتممت كل المهام؟ هل صنفتها بشكل صحيح؟ -> If coverage <95% refine query
self_review_mechanism.validation: REQUIRED minimal schema per pattern: id, name, at least one of {detection|method|formula|pattern|description}, confidence. RECOMMENDED but currently incomplete across the corpus: examples (~12%) and per-pattern sources (~1%). This is a documentation debt, not a claim of completeness.
self_review_mechanism.anti_stop: counter patterns <15 triggers continuation, checklist source types >=3 per file
self_review_mechanism.confidence_semantics: confidence = subjective editorial prior, NOT a calibrated probability. See each file _v2_meta.disclaimers.

theoretical_limits.key_result: Sadasivan et al. 2303.11156 (TMLR): as the model distribution approaches the human distribution, the AUROC of ANY detector is bounded by the total-variation distance between them -> reliable statistical detection without watermark/external evidence becomes impossible in the limit.
theoretical_limits.counterpoint: Chakraborty et al. argue detection remains possible given enough samples / longer text; the practical takeaway is management, not a hard impossibility.
theoretical_limits.implication: Do not build systems that assume 100% detection. Prioritise watermarking + external evidence + human review over pure text-internal classification.
